techtower._apiKey_note: Attio runs via the connected account in this environment, so no token is needed and this stays empty. ONLY if a scheduled run's preflight shows Attio unavailable headless: put a real token in attio.local.json (gitignored) or the ATTIO_API_KEY env secret — NEVER here in git.
techtower._objects_note: Object slugs the sweep will try to match a contact/company against, in priority order. Confirm these exist via GET /v2/objects.
techtower._match_note: Which attribute to match the email sender / company on, per object.

writeBack._optional_attrs: If these custom attributes exist on the object, the sweep will set them. Leave blank to skip. Use the attribute slug from GET /v2/objects/{object}/attributes.
writeBack._stage_note: Auto-advancing a deal stage is OFF by default and ALWAYS requires explicit approval in the run. Never set this to auto-close/auto-win.

_newDealDiscovery_note: W0 (new-deal-discovery.md). Scans yesterday's inbound for genuine NEW opportunities not in Attio and creates deal + links company + person + adds a [new-deal] note. enabled=true turns it on. Committed config (no secrets).
_attioIngest_note: W1 (attio-ingest.md). Daily ingest: writes ALL raw comms to Attio as notes + keeps stages current. createNewDeals stays false (creation is W0's job — org-linking below is the one narrow exception). enabled=true turns it on. Committed config (no secrets).
_stages_note: Verified live against Attio list-attribute-definitions(deals, stage) on 2026-07-25 — these are the ACTUAL current stage titles/ids. Previous config had drifted (e.g. '1.  Positive reply' vs the real '1.  Reply', and a '7. Active Project Client' stage that doesn't exist) — re-verify this way before trusting stage names if they're ever suspect again.
_stagePolicy_note: 2026-07-25, per Shaffy (final version, after two rounds of correction). Every deal is either 'live' (W1 may move its stage per evidence, including reactivating a Nurture deal on real new activity) or 'frozen' (W1 never touches its stage — Shaffy manages progression from there by hand, e.g. moving Scope agreed → Proposal sent, or closing a deal). The ONE crossing allowed is a live deal graduating INTO 'Scope agreed' on clear evidence — after that it's frozen. This governs stage changes ONLY; deal_description/next_step refresh (see fieldRefresh) and Attio Tasks apply regardless of live/frozen.

stagePolicy._frozen_note: Once a deal is in a frozen stage, W1 never changes `stage` on it — not forward, not back, not even to Lost. Note what happened and let Shaffy move it.

callBooked.when: a call/meeting gets booked on a deal at '1.  Reply'

demoOrScopingCallHeld.when: a demo/scoping call gets booked or held on a deal at '2. Planning call'

scopeAgreedLive.when: live scoping/handshake on scope is reached — the one case a live-stage deal graduates into a frozen stage; it stays frozen from there

explicitOptOut.when: the reply is a plain opt-out/negative (unsubscribe, 'not interested', 'remove me') — hygiene, not demotion; only applies to deals currently in a live stage

goneQuiet.when: no reply/meeting for more than recencyWeeks and the deal is still in a live stage

nurtureReactivation.when: a 'Nurture / recontact' deal gets a genuinely new inbound thread or meeting (not just a re-read of old context)
nurtureReactivation.to: whichever live stage the fresh evidence fits — usually '1.  Reply' for a bare reply, '2. Planning call' if a call got booked directly
nurtureReactivation.note: Record the reactivation explicitly in the note (why it's back, what's new) so it doesn't read as a silent stage flip.

stagePolicy._lostReactivation_note: Lost deals are NOT auto-reactivated — an explicit 'not interested' is a stronger signal than mere silence. If a Lost deal shows a genuine positive reversal, flag it in the digest for Shaffy to move manually rather than reactivating it automatically.

_fieldRefresh_note: 2026-07-25, per Shaffy (final version): deal_description and next_step get refreshed on EVERY deal W1 writes a note on this run, regardless of stage — early pipeline, Nurture, or frozen/advanced (Scope agreed, Active client, etc). There is no stage restriction on the field refresh; the stage-change restriction (stagePolicy.frozenStages) is separate and doesn't limit this. Both fields already existed on the deals object, unused, before 2026-07-25.

fieldRefresh.scope: every deal a note is written on this run — no stage restriction

_orgLinking_note: 2026-07-25, per Shaffy: whenever W1 touches a deal (any stage, any note), make sure it has a linked Company and a linked Person for the actual counterpart in the conversation — find-or-create both, don't just flag the gap. This replaces the older 'never create people/companies' restriction; deal creation itself is still W0's job only (attioIngest.createNewDeals stays false).

orgLinking._personalDomains_note: Don't create a company from a personal-domain contact email — link the person, skip the company, flag in the digest instead of guessing an employer.
orgLinking._dedup_note: Always search first (company by domain, person by email) and reuse an exact match — never create a duplicate. If a create hits a domain/email conflict, reuse the existing record's id from the error.

_tasks_note: 2026-07-25, per Shaffy: whenever the sweep finds something clearly owed on TechTower's side, create a native Attio Task linked to the deal so it shows up in Attio's own task list, not just the note/digest. High bar, same spirit as the SwimScore/HubSpot version: only for an explicit unanswered question/request, or a clearly important flag — not general nudges. Applies regardless of stage/live-vs-frozen. Mirrors mcp__Attio__create-task / list-tasks / update-task. Attio tasks have no editable body after creation and no priority field — completion is the only state change (mcp__Attio__update-task, is_completed:true) once a fresh note shows the item was resolved.

tasks._defaultAssignee_note: Shaffy Roell's Attio workspace_member_id (confirmed via mcp__Attio__whoami).
tasks.contentFormat: <Verb> <what> — <who/what it's for>, then a blank line, then the dedup Ref line
tasks._dedup_note: Before creating a task, call mcp__Attio__list-tasks with linked_record_object='deals', linked_record_id=<dealId>, is_completed=false and check each task's content for an existing Ref line match — skip creating a duplicate if found. If a prior open task's underlying item is now resolved (evidenced by fresh note content), call mcp__Attio__update-task with is_completed:true instead of leaving it stale.
tasks._verifyNotDone_note: MANDATORY before every create: re-check the deal's existing notes and latest activity for that item specifically — confirm the reply/action hasn't already happened.
tasks.dueDateRule: Default deadline_at = today. Never leave it blank.
